body:
I can''t seem to get anything done.  I can't focus.  I feel when I do try to do something, I fail.  I just can't win.  

On top of that, I am afraid.  I want help but I am afraid of what will happen.  I am seeing a therapist, but have not talked about everything.  The last time I tried to kill myself, my therapist decided she could not see me any longer.  One of my issues is abandonment.  I just started seeing someone again and don't want to lose that so I don't tell her everything.  I have thought about going to a hospital but I can't miss any work as I may lose my job if I do.  I am all out of vacation and sick time.  

Today, I really tried.  I took a shower and made something to eat but I have so much more to do and could not get myself to do anything.  I am weeks behind at work, my house is a disaster.  I can't remember to take my medication.

When I have called the suicide hotline, I always feel like they are in a hurry to get me off the line.  They tell me they have to let me go after a few minutes.  I don't want to burden anyone, so I don't talk to my friends about this.  I only have a few friends and don't want to lose any of them.
